# dsh-brain-viewer

An **AI brain viewer** for DeepSeek Harness:
a brain-shaped relationship graph that opens from the l

eft sidebar, plus a Markdown
knowledge-base pipeline that turns a folder of notes into that graph.
## What it does

- **Left sidebar entry** — a `🧠 AI Brain` button at the bottom of the sidebar opens a
full-screen re

lationship graph.
- **Brain-shaped layout** — thousands of notes are packed into a real brain silhou

ette
(sampled from the 🧠 emoji outline), with cluster hubs, drifting neurons, hover
highlighting, dr

ag-and-rebound and synapse pulses.
- **Knowledge pipeline included** — `brain/` ships the full Markd

own pipeline:
scan a workspace (`md` / `docx` / `xlsx`) → split documents into memory units →
write

Obsidian-compatible `[[wiki-link]]` notes → compile the graph.
- **Session auto-review ingest (v0.4.

0)** — one click in the panel header turns today's DSH
sessions into episode memories in the vault a

nd rebuilds the graph. Fully local, no LLM calls.
- **Demo data** — the package ships a generic demo

vault, so it works out of the box.
Nothing personal is bundled.

## Session auto-review ingest (v0.4.0)

Every DSH session is a zstd-compressed JSONL log at
`~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<session-id>/sessio

n.v4.jsonl.zstd`. The panel header now has a
**Session ingest** button plus a status line (`N ingest

ed today · latest YYYY-MM-DD · M sessions visible`).
It turns **today's** sessions into one episode

YYY-MM-DD · M sessions visible`).
It turns **today's** sessions into one episode memory per session:
| Route | What it does |
| `GET /api/dsh-brain/ingest/status` | today's ingested count, latest memory date, visible sessions

|
| `POST /api/dsh-brain/ingest/run` | scan today's sessions → write episode notes → rebuild the gra
ph → `{written, updated, skipped, nodes}` |

Extraction is local, deterministic and does **not** call a model: the first real user message
become

s the title, user intents and the assistant's final text become the body, tool usage is
summarised,

and the note is linked to 2–3 existing hub notes. Notes land in
`vault/episodes/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD ·
会话复盘 · <title> (<session-id>).md`.

**Idempotent** — each generated note carries `source: dsh-session-ingest` and `session: <id>` in
its

frontmatter. Clicking again rewrites the *same* file only when the session changed; it never
duplic

ates notes. Subagent (child) sessions and sessions from other workspaces are skipped by
default (`in
cludeSubagent: true` to opt in).
Configure the vault — `vault/` and `build_graph.py` are inferred from `graphPath` when possible:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Only `graphPath` or `vaultPath` is required. Without a configured vault the plugin **refuses to
writ
e**, so the bundled demo vault is never polluted. Same workflow from the CLI:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Requirements: a Node with zstd support for ingest (Node >= 22.15 or >= 23.8; DSH ships Node 24)
and

Python only for the graph rebuild. If `build_graph.py` fails, the notes are still written and
the re
sponse reports `graph.ok: false` plus a warning.
## Performance (v0.3.1)
- **WebGL batch rendering**: nodes are instanced quads and links a single `gl.LINES` batch; pan/zoom
only updates a matrix instead of rebuilding geometry. A 6,398-node graph renders in **0.6–1.2 ms pe

r frame** (the old Canvas2D path was ~90 ms/frame).
- **Render on demand**: no `requestAnimationFram
e` at all while nothing is animating or interacting (0 frames at rest) — the same strategy as Obsidi

an's graph view. Continuous frames only while the drift / pulse toggles are on.
- **Label LOD**: lab
els appear by zoom threshold, capped at 64 with overlap culling; labels and highlights live on a sep

arate 2D overlay that draws only the few needed.
- **Data over a host route**: `client.js` dropped f

rom 1 MB to ~0.1 MB; data never ships in the bundle and changes need no repack.
- Without WebGL it f

alls back to batched 2D paths and still renders on demand.
- Closing the panel unmounts the iframe,
so it costs no CPU when idle.
## Privacy

- The demo vault is generated from generic content (`brain/seed_demo.py`).
- `tools/rebuild.mjs --wo

rkspace` reads files **locally only**; nothing is uploaded.
- The graph is rendered in an iframe fro
m a local Blob URL; no network requests.
## Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or delete `dsh-brain-viewer` from the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`.
